description.value: Hellcrust Pizza is a Canadian-owned franchise chain that distinguishes itself through Biga preferment dough prepared a day or two in advance for improved digestibility and flavour, positioning itself against mass-market pizza on ingredient quality. The Davie Street location is one of 18+ outlets across BC and Alberta and offers both dine-in and online ordering. Touring cyclists will find a broad menu with dedicated vegan pizzas made with Daiya cheese, gluten-free options, and a range of appetisers and baked pastas.

Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms active online ordering across all menu items and a dedicated 'Vegan Pizzas (Made with Daiya cheese)' section, corroborating OSM tags diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes, diet:gluten_free=yes (all surveyed 2026-05-16). No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The contact page shows only an email address (info@hellcrustpizza.com), so the OSM phone number and specific street address cannot be confirmed from the website scrape.
concerns: Name capitalisation mismatch: OSM records 'Hellcrust Pizza' but website consistently uses 'HellCrust Pizza' and in some places 'Hell Crust Pizza'.
Phone number (+1-604-428-6909) unverifiable from website — contact page lists only info@hellcrustpizza.com with no phone number shown.
Specific street address (1112 Davie St) does not appear in scraped website content; the store locator ('Find a Store') was not fully captured.
OSM was:name tag indicates the location previously traded as 'City Square Pizza'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate food-and-drink stop with strong dietary variety for cyclists, but the required 'Bike parking or visibility' criterion cannot be confirmed from available evidence; an on-the-ground check is needed before accreditation.
